== Summary ==
Lossless composition of the official source image with its original PDF transparency mask for [[Dice Ibegon (V) (Errata 3)]]. Source: [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf]], page 2, image xref 12, mask xref 11. The original image bytes are preserved at [[:File:V7-L-diceibegon-Set7-September-2023-partial-source.jpeg]]; the complete original PDF retains both image and mask. PDF SHA-256 <code>597c96306746c8958d56283651afdf714ff23b88e847e86bbc39e319c578e363</code>; embedded JPEG SHA-256 <code>d57b7417538e9a2f8303791f4c6b2146c306210c44bae90feaf3446f66389919</code>; original mask stream SHA-256 <code>de2f895e5e3c01e23774aa32fd0a495423da49d78418874906be48469ba1db65</code>. Printed edition: September 2023. No exact first-publication day established. Lucasfilm Ltd.; original slip published by the Players Committee.
